problem_statement:
DbMapper is not invoked for DML operations
## Environment Details
* Helidon Version: 4.3.1
* Helidon SE 
* JDK version: 21
* OS: macOS

----------

## Problem Description
DbMapper is not applied when executing a DML statements
Easily reproducible

## Steps to reproduce
1. Create custom DbMapper and implement abstract methods 
2. Register custom DbMapper with DbMapperProvider
3. Apply provider to the DbClient configuration 
4. Create DbExecute and DbStatementDml
5. Set relevant type of parameter and execute the statement
6. Place breakpoints into DbMapper methods"
7. Run application in debug mode.
8. Observe statement execution exceptions that are the result of the DbMapper not applied.
9. Notice that one of the breakpoints in the DbMaper where ever triggered.
10. Try to execute DbStatementGet with the same mapper.
11. Notice the query operation works and the relevant breakpoint is triggered in the DbMapper.

[shopHdbClient.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/23418837/shopHdbClient.zip)
all_hints_text:
@hyder
Update: After extensive testing I figured out that the the DbMapper is ONLY triggered when application set parameters via these methods calls:
```java
statement.indexedParam(obj);
statement.namedParam(obj);
```
but NOT via any of the addParam or addParams methods variants. 
Also, counterintuitively the statement has to specify the exact structure of what parameters should be mapped to, not what you set as a parameter, i.e. you set an object (in my example instance of Product) as an argument, but the query should layout the exact structure to which his object should be mapped by the DbMapper:
```json
create-product3: '{
  "collection": "products",
  "operation": "insert",
  "value": {
    "id": $id,
    "name": $name,
    "price": $price,
    "bestBefore": $bestBefore,
    "category": $category,
    "version": $version
  }
}'
```
Not this:
```json
create-product1: '{
  "collection": "products",
  "operation": "insert",
  "value": {
    "product": $product
  }
}'
```
In my actual example I'm also using an array of reviews, but I did not yet figure out what the syntax of the statement for this structure should be, but since this array is an optional element according to the JSON Schema it can be omitted to make this test work and demonstrate the conditions under which the DbMapper invocation is triggered.
